## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Offline browser acceptance passes.
- [ ] GitHub Pages subpath acceptance passes when routing/assets changed.
- [ ] Live feed/proxy/translation acceptance is recorded separately when those services changed.
- [ ] UI changes include screenshots at desktop and mobile widths.
- [ ] The change preserves the simulation-only boundary and does not imply real payments, provider access, financial rights, or guaranteed third-party uptime.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to browser storage, feed schemas, catalogue data, routes, static export, proxies, translation, or accessibility.
